mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_data ( user_platform, user_uuid, user_nickname, user_ruby, user_gold, user_bp, user_level, user_level_experience, user_level_experience_max, user_key, user_key_remain_time, user_key_last_charge_time, user_game_count, user_epic_bag_max, user_epic_skill_1, user_epic_skill_2, advertisement_buy_yn, use_yn, plus_skill_point, last_login, user_position, user_insert_date) VALUES ( #{platform}, #{user_uuid}, #{user_nickname}, '1000', '10000', '0', '1', '0', '0', '50', '60', Now(), '0', '300', '0', '0', 'N', 'Y', '0', Now(), #{user_position}, Now())
mapper.select: SELECT a.user_uuid, a.user_nickname, a.user_ruby, a.user_gold, a.user_bp, a.user_level, a.user_level_experience, a.user_level_experience_max, a.user_key, a.user_key_remain_time, a.user_key_last_charge_time, a.user_game_count, a.user_epic_bag_max, a.user_epic_skill_1, a.user_epic_skill_2, a.advertisement_buy_yn, a.use_yn, a.plus_skill_point, a.last_login, a.user_position, a.user_token, b.*, c.* FROM user_data a LEFT JOIN advertisement_time_data b ON a.user_uuid = b.user_uuid LEFT JOIN exp_booster_data c ON a.user_uuid = c.user_uuid where a.user_uuid = #{user_uuid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_login_log (user_uuid, user_nickname, ins_date, ins_ip, ins_machine) VALUES (#{user_uuid}, #{user_nickname}, NOW(), #{ins_ip}, #{ins_machine})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_data SET user_game_count=user_game_count+1 WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid}
UPDATE user_data SET advertisement_buy_yn = 'Y' WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid}
UPDATE user_data SET last_login = Now() WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_recommendations (from_user_uuid, to_user_uuid, ins_data, ins_ip, ins_machine) VALUES (#{user_uuid}, #{to_user_uuid}, NOW(), #{ins_ip}, #{ins_machine})
INSERT INTO user_linked_log (guest_user_uuid, normal_user_uuid, ins_data, ins_ip, ins_machine) VALUES (#{guest_user_uuid}, #{normal_user_uuid}, NOW(), #{ins_ip}, #{ins_machine})
mapper.update: UPDATE user_data SET user_uuid = #{normal_user_uuid}, user_position = 'normal' WHERE user_uuid = #{guest_user_uuid}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as cafe_event_YN FROM user_mail_data WHERE user_uuid = #{user_uuid} AND reward_unique = 'cafe_join_event'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_mail_data (user_uuid, all_mail_unique, reward_unique, mail_title, mail_content, mail_sender, mail_start_date, mail_end_date, mail_note, use_yn, ins_date) VALUES (#{user_uuid}, CONCAT('cafe_join_event_', #{user_uuid}), 'cafe_join_event', '카페 가입 이벤트 참여 보상', '안녕하세요. 공식 카페에 가입해 주셔서 감사합니다!', '운영진', Now(), ADDDATE(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY), '카페 가입 이벤트 참여 보상', 'Y', Now())
